laparoscopic_or_endoscopic.why: Minimally invasive cases often take longer than table-only expectations.

endotracheal_intubation.why: Signals airway management and general anesthesia details associated with longer cases.

estimated_blood_loss_ml.why: Higher blood loss is a direct marker of operative complexity and prolongation.

adhesiolysis_or_adhesions.why: Adhesions commonly increase dissection time and operative difficulty.

bilateral_procedure.why: Bilateral operations usually take longer than unilateral procedures.

multiple_procedures_or_additional_proced.why: Extra procedures or combined operations increase duration beyond the primary specialty baseline.

drain_or_tube_placed.why: Placement of drains or tubes often reflects more extensive surgery or added steps.

conversion_to_open.why: Conversion from minimally invasive to open surgery is a strong marker of longer duration.
